status: PRE-REGISTERED: committed before the repaired helper, the recursive comparator, the runner and the tests existed, and before the baseline was run on the new fixtures. Not edited after results are seen; post-run notes go to REPORT.md, labelled as such.
scope: Evidence integrity of the research helper only: parser diagnostics, the removed byte-span claim, distinct identities, and replay comparison. A structurally complete unit is not a claim that the passage answers any question.

defects.D1: build_candidate() keeps only diagnostics whose line lies between the unit's first and last ELEMENT START lines; a diagnostic later inside a dd (or anywhere else on the page) is dropped from the decision and the unit can still be OK_STRUCTURAL_UNIT
defects.D2: raw_byte_span is derived from data.count()/data.find() of the serialization: a unique literal match can lie in a comment (or anywhere) rather than at the selected live node, so it is no node-to-source alignment
defects.D2b: the pre-registered rule and the tests say the UTF-8 serialization is searched; the implementation encodes it with docinfo.encoding, so for a windows-1252 page the claimed span holds windows-1252 bytes that are not the UTF-8 serialization whose sha256/bytes are reported
defects.D3: compare_results.py says it ignores only the platform fields but compares a digest that omits case id, anchor, source identity, parser encoding, diagnostic column/level/message, candidate kind and payload texts, context text and check details, never compares the environment (library versions included), conflates true with 1 and 1 with 1.0, and crashes on a different result count

repaired_rules.R1_parser_diagnostics: any entry in the document's parser error log, at any line, adds the reason PARSER_DIAGNOSTICS_PRESENT (so every representation is REVIEW); the candidate is still built and kept whole; parser.diagnostics keeps every entry with line, column, level, type and message; no line filter, no end range from start lines, no page exempted. PARSER_RECOVERY_IN_UNIT and candidate.diagnostics_in_unit_lines are removed.
repaired_rules.R2_no_source_alignment: the helper produces no byte span, offset or literal occurrence count: raw_byte_span and raw_occurrences_of_serialization are removed; no output key name contains span, offset, occurrence, byte_start, byte_end or in_unit

R3_identities.file: source.sha256 and source.bytes: the retained file bytes exactly as received
R3_identities.dom_serialization: candidate.dom_sha256 and candidate.dom_bytes: the UTF-8 encoding of the unit's unicode DOM serialization, whatever the document encoding
R3_identities.text_content: candidate.text_sha256 and candidate.text_bytes: the UTF-8 encoding of the unit's text_content()
R3_identities.document_encoding: parser.encoding: the encoding lxml/libxml2 report for decoding the file bytes (docinfo.encoding); reported, used for no identity

repaired_rules.R4_budget_scope: context_bytes counts the research context built from context_template only; each contexts entry carries the scope string below; fits=true is not an admission decision for any real caller
repaired_rules.R5_comparison: compare_results.py compares two JSON documents recursively and completely: same JSON type at every path (bool, int and float distinct), same object keys in the same order, same array length and order, same scalar values; duplicate object keys or non-standard constants (NaN, Infinity) make the input invalid (exit 2). Only the values at the exact paths in environment_exceptions may differ (the keys must exist on both sides). Exit 0 when nothing else differs, 1 otherwise.

budget_scope: research context only: the context_template lines (query, source identity, origin, unit and representation labels) and the payload; a real caller's question, instructions, system prompt and message wrappers are not counted, so fits=true is no admission decision for any caller
context_template: unit: {kind} signatures={signatures} descriptions={descriptions} start_lines={first_line}-{last_line} (parser-reported element start lines; not byte offsets)
context_template_note: unchanged from the previous increment, so the 27 old contexts must stay byte-identical
